description: Default capabilities for Privacy Gate webview (api.md §8, ui.md §3.2). W29: grants the two events, save-only dialog, and write-only in-memory-bytes fs; every Tauri command this app registers is app-defined (invoke_handler's generate_handler! list, not this ACL) and reachable once core:default grants IPC at all — see src-tauri/src/main.rs. Trailing entries under "deny" for http/shell/dialog-open are trip wires: no HTTP or shell plugin is a dependency of this crate at all (Cloud AI HTTP is Rust-side only via reqwest in pg-core, architecture §9.2), so those permissions do not currently exist to grant; listing them denied means adding either plugin later for an unrelated reason does not silently open this webview's capability surface.
